strings.2008 年 1 月 26 日，腊月十九，傍晚六点。京珠高速湖南郴州段，往北的车: Six in the evening, January 26, 2008 — nineteenth day of the twelfth lunar month. On the Jingzhu Expressway through Chenzhou, Hunan, the northbound traffic has come to a dead stop on a climb through the hills. It has been raining freezing rain for days; the road wears a clear skin of ice, and the cars ahead sit nose to tail with their hazards blinking, all the way round the bend and out of sight.

strings.一氧化碳：排气管口被冰糊住、车窗关得死死的，尾气就会倒灌进车里。一氧化碳没有颜色: Carbon monoxide: when the tailpipes ice over and the windows are shut tight, exhaust leaks back into the cabin. CO has no colour and no smell, and binds to haemoglobin over two hundred times more strongly than oxygen. First come headaches and nausea; people who are asleep may never wake. The old, the young and anyone with a weak heart are most at risk. Cracking the windows, clearing the tailpipes and keeping watch cut the risk a long way down.

A nineteen-year-old recruit raps on the coach window and passes in a crate of steamed buns and bottled water. “Boss, this stretch is ours now.”

strings.你一路都在用 MP3 的录音功能偷偷录大家说的话，还偷拍了不少照片。编辑说过：写: All along you've been secretly recording what everyone says on your MP3 player, and taking photos on the sly. Your editor told you: make it harrowing enough and it's the front page.

strings.停在一起的是一辆开往湖北的卧铺大巴、一辆拉砂糖橘的半挂车、一辆黑色帕萨特和一辆银: Stuck together are a sleeper coach bound for Hubei, a semi-trailer loaded with mandarins, a black Passat and a small silver saloon. In the afternoon the coach driver said he would walk to the toll station ahead to find out what was going on; half the passengers went with him, and none of them came back. The six adults left behind, a four-year-old girl, an old man with a bad heart and a dog in the lorry's cab now have only each other.

strings.冻雨一下就厚一层。抢修队凿冰、撒盐，出太阳的时候才会变薄。: Every spell of freezing rain adds a layer. It only thins when the crews chip and salt it, or when the sun comes out.
strings.冻雨又密又急。坡上不时传来咔嚓咔嚓的声音，是竹子和树枝被冰压断了。: The freezing rain comes down thick and fast. Every so often there is a crack on the slope above — bamboo and branches snapping under the weight of the ice.
strings.冻雨是过冷的雨滴，零度以下还是水，一碰到东西就结冰。: Freezing rain is supercooled droplets — still liquid below zero, and the moment they touch anything, they freeze.
strings.冻雨：0°C 上下的雨，落到哪里就冻在哪里。衣服湿了体感要低 6°C；湿着坐进不: Freezing rain: rain at around 0°C freezes on whatever it touches. Wet clothes make it feel 6°C colder; sit in an unheated car in wet clothes and your core temperature creeps down — faster if you are hungry or worn out.
strings.凌晨四点，有人迷迷糊糊推开车门，一头栽在冰面上。车里的人一个个叫不醒，嘴唇红得不: At four in the morning someone stumbles to the door, shoves it open and pitches face-first onto the ice. Inside, one after another, people won't wake, their lips an unnatural red. The engine is still chugging away, its tailpipe caked thick with ice. Carbon monoxide.

strings.十几个人喊着号子推，那辆大客车终于打着了火。车上的人从车窗里伸出手来，一个劲地拍: A dozen people heave to a chant until the stalled coach roars into life. Its passengers lean out of the windows and clap and clap.
strings.十几个人在冰上推着车，一寸一寸地挪。救护车从缝里钻了过去，车上的医生冲大家挥了挥: A dozen people push the cars along the ice an inch at a time. The ambulance squeezes through the gap, and the doctor inside waves to them all.
strings.半夜虎子突然狂叫起来，冲着半挂车后面扑。手电一照，两个人影拎着塑料桶正往黑暗里跑: In the middle of the night Tiger erupts into furious barking and lunges at the back of the lorry. A torch beam catches two figures with plastic jerrycans running off into the dark.
strings.半夜里，半挂车车厢底下冒起了烟。先是噼里啪啦几声，接着一串炮仗在车厢里炸开了，火: In the night, smoke starts curling from under the lorry's trailer. First a few pops and crackles, then a string of firecrackers goes off inside and flame spits out through the gaps in the doors. There are still a dozen-odd cases at the very back.
strings.半夜里，对面山梁上传来一串闷响，像打雷。天亮一看，一座输电铁塔被冰压得拦腰折断，: In the night a string of dull booms rolls across from the ridge opposite, like thunder. At first light you see it: a power pylon has buckled at the waist under the ice, and its heavy cables sag all the way down into the fields at the foot of the cutting. Aoshang and the whole road have lost power.
strings.半夜，{actor} 下车去护栏外面方便。脚刚落地，冰面就滑了一下。: In the middle of the night {actor} climbs down to go to the toilet behind the guardrail. The moment {actor.his} feet touch the ground, they skid.
strings.半夜，一根水管插进了半挂车的油箱。: In the dead of night, a hose slides into the lorry's tank.
strings.卖红薯的老汉姓谢，看见车里有孩子，又多塞了两个，没要钱。: The sweet-potato man is called Xie. Seeing there's a child aboard, he slips in two extra and won't take any money for them.
strings.卖鸡蛋的大嫂翻了个白眼：“爱买不买，后头的车多得很。”价钱反倒涨了。: The egg seller rolls her eyes. “Buy or don't — there are plenty more cars back there.” If anything, the price goes up.
strings.卧铺上吵吵嚷嚷，到半夜才散。: The bunks are noisy until past midnight.
strings.厂子年前就撑不下去了。你把账上最后的十八万取成现金锁在密码箱里，三十多个工人的工: The factory went under before New Year. You drew the last 180,000 yuan out of the account in cash and locked it in the briefcase. Thirty-odd workers haven't been paid a fen; you switched your phone off and hit the road.
strings.原型：2008 年 1 月中旬到 2 月初的南方低温雨雪冰冻灾害。正赶上春运，连: Based on the ice storm that hit southern China from mid-January to early February 2008. It struck at the height of the Spring Festival travel rush: day after day of freezing rain turned the Jingzhu Expressway through Chenzhou, Hunan, into a sheet of ice, and tens of thousands of vehicles were stranded on it for days. Power pylons around Chenzhou buckled under the ice, and the city went without power and water for more than a week. Soldiers, armed police, traffic police and road crews chipped the ice away inch by inch with steel bars and pickaxes and spread salt and grit; villagers along the road carried food and water up the embankments, and some of them charged ten or twenty yuan for a bowl of instant noodles. The characters and what happens to them are fictional.

strings.各人包里的饼干、方便面、卤蛋，还有带回家过年的腊肠和年糕。: Biscuits, instant noodles and marinated eggs from people's bags, plus the sausages and rice cakes they were taking home for New Year.
strings.各人回了各人的车。半夜里，几辆车的尾灯在冰雨里亮成一排。: Everyone goes back to their own vehicle. Through the night, a row of tail lights glows in the icy rain.
strings.各回各的车，各开各的暖风: Everyone back to their own vehicle, each with its own heater
strings.后半夜，{actor} 看见田秀芬背过身去，用一根针挑开棉袄的线，抽出一张红票子: In the small hours {actor} sees Fiona Tian turn her back, unpick the stitching of her jacket with a needle, slide out a red hundred-yuan note and quickly sew it up again. The lining is stuffed fat.
strings.后半夜，你看见应急车道上的车挪开了一截，一直空到前面的弯道。你的帕萨特离那个口子: In the small hours you notice the cars on the hard shoulder have shuffled forward, leaving it clear right up to the bend. Your Passat is a dozen metres from the gap. Drive up the hard shoulder and you might squeeze through to the next exit.
strings.后半夜，曾老师捂着胸口蜷在卧铺上，额头上全是冷汗，嘴唇发紫。他摆摆手说没事，可那: In the small hours Mr. Zeng lies curled on his bunk clutching his chest, his forehead beaded with cold sweat, his lips blue. He waves a hand to say it's nothing, but the hand is trembling.
strings.后来交警清点滞留车辆的时候，那辆卧铺大巴边上，只有一个人活了下来：{surviv: Later, when the traffic police went along counting the stranded vehicles, only one person from that sleeper coach had lived: {survivors}. Those who never got off the ice: {dead}. Years afterwards, whenever there is freezing rain on the television news, that person switches it off.
strings.后面一辆大巴上有个乡村医生，给了一卷纱布和一瓶碘伏: A village doctor on a coach further back hands over a roll of gauze and a bottle of iodine
strings.后面那辆车的人不认账，推搡起来，有人挨了一拳。: The people in the car behind deny everything; there's shoving, and someone takes a punch.
strings.向阳在京珠高速上凿了十一天冰。归队那天，他把磨破的手套留在了收费站，跟中队一起坐: Ray Xiang chipped ice on the Jingzhu Expressway for eleven days. The day his company pulled out, he left his worn-through gloves at the toll station and rode back to Chenzhou in the back of a truck. He didn't get home for New Year that year.
strings.向阳没能归队。中队的战友把他的十字镐带回了营房，挂在荣誉室的墙上。: Ray Xiang never rejoined his company. His comrades carried his pickaxe back to barracks and hung it on the wall of the honours room.
strings.听听他怎么说: Hear what he has to say
strings.听着，心里有了点底: Listen, and feel a little steadier

strings.喝酒驱寒是假的：酒让人觉得暖和，身上的热气反倒散得更快: Drinking to keep out the cold is a myth: it makes you feel warm while your body loses heat faster
strings.四岁，在东莞出生，还没回过老家。穿一件粉红色的棉袄，揣着一个要送给哥哥的变形金刚: Four years old, born in Dongguan, and never yet been to the family's home village. She wears a pink padded jacket and carries a Transformer she's taking for her big brother.

strings.大巴里的人冻得睡不着。半挂车就停在旁边，油箱里还有一百多升柴油。有人凑到 {le: Nobody in the coach can sleep for the cold. The lorry is parked right beside them with over a hundred litres in its tank. Someone leans over to {leader}: “Wait till he's asleep and take thirty litres. He'll never notice.”

strings.天亮的时候，曾老师的脉慢慢稳住了。: By dawn Mr. Zeng's pulse has slowly steadied.

A traffic officer wrote the vehicles' plates on his form and added one more line: occupants remaining in the vehicles — none survived.

strings.护主，机灵，见了孩子就摇尾巴。: Loyal and sharp; wags his tail the moment he sees a child.

strings.攒的钱花掉了一截，田秀芬心疼了很久。可年三十晚上，一家人围着火盆，丫丫在她怀里睡: A good chunk of the savings went, and it hurt her for a long time. But on New Year's Eve, with the family round the brazier and Ava asleep in her lap, she decided it had been worth it after all.

strings.教了三十多年物理。冠心病，前年装过支架，口袋里总揣着一小瓶硝酸甘油。耳朵有点背，: Taught physics for over thirty years. Coronary heart disease; had a stent put in two years ago and always carries a little bottle of nitroglycerin. A bit hard of hearing, but sharper than anyone.
strings.敲下护栏和车顶上的冰，装进锅和瓶子里化开。火桶烧着的时候能烧开一大锅；只开着暖风: Knock the ice off the guardrail and the roofs and melt it in pots and bottles. With the fire barrel going you can boil a whole potful; with only the heater running you can wedge bottles against the vents and the dashboard and wait; with neither, all you get is a trickle of drips, and your hands ache with cold.
strings.整整一个钟头，半挂车在冰雨里烧成了一个火球，烟花一阵一阵地往天上蹿。: For a whole hour the lorry burns like a fireball in the icy rain, fireworks shooting into the sky in bursts.
strings.早上一看，大巴的油箱盖被撬开了，地上一摊柴油冻成了油冰——夜里有人偷油。: In the morning you find the coach's fuel cap prised off and a puddle of diesel frozen into the ice beneath it. Someone stole fuel in the night.
strings.早上醒来，车里好几个人头疼得像要裂开，恶心，眼前发花，有人怎么叫都迷迷糊糊的。排: In the morning several people wake with splitting headaches, nausea and swimming eyes, and one of them won't come round properly however much they're called. The tailpipes are crusted with ice and the windows are shut tight. It's carbon monoxide.
strings.明天推选人选。路上可能摔伤、冻伤，一来一回要一整天: Choose tomorrow. They could fall or freeze on the way, and the round trip takes a whole day
strings.易凡后来很少说起那几天。: Felix Yi seldom talks about those days.
strings.易凡回到益阳，那篇稿子写了改、改了写，最后没有发出去。他把录音存进一个文件夹，起: Felix Yi went home to Yiyang. He wrote the piece, rewrote it, rewrote it again, and in the end never filed it. He saved the recordings in a folder named “Nineteenth of the Twelfth Month”.
strings.易凡没能回到益阳。报社在他的 MP3 里找到几十段录音，最后一段是半夜录的，只有: Felix Yi never made it home to Yiyang. The paper found dozens of recordings on his MP3 player. The last was made in the middle of the night: just the wind, an engine, and several people breathing in their sleep. His editor finished the story for him.
strings.易凡的稿子登在了报纸的第七版，标题是《冰道上的六天》。他把每个人的名字都改了，可: Felix Yi's piece ran on page seven under the headline “Six Days on the Ice Road”. He changed everyone's names, but the people from the coach knew at once who was who. A few of them later wrote to the paper asking for his number.
strings.易凡红着脸说，他想让外面的人知道这条路上是什么样子。: Felix Yi goes red and says he wants the outside world to know what it's like on this road.
strings.易凡被赶下了车，一个人顺着车流往收费站走。他一路走一路问，一路记，走到收费站的时: Felix Yi was put off the coach and walked alone up the line of traffic towards the toll station, asking questions and taking notes all the way. By the time he got there his notebook was full.
strings.春运路上，冻雨把京珠高速封成了一面冰。车里有暖风，也有看不见的一氧化碳。: Spring Festival traffic, and freezing rain has sealed the expressway under a sheet of ice. The engines give heat — and a gas you cannot see.
strings.是冻的、饿的，跟暖风没关系: It's the cold and hunger — nothing to do with the heater
strings.暖和一些；炭火一样出一氧化碳: A bit warmer — but charcoal gives off carbon monoxide just the same
strings.曾丽娟从双肩包的夹层里摸出一个小药瓶。旁边的人都看见了：那个夹层里，一板一板全是: Lisa Zeng pulls a little bottle from an inner pocket of her backpack — and everyone nearby sees it: the pocket is packed with strip after strip of pills.
strings.曾丽娟后来考了急救培训师的证，每年冬天都去高速公路的服务区，给司机们讲一氧化碳。: Lisa Zeng later qualified as a first-aid instructor. Every winter she goes round the expressway service areas, talking to drivers about carbon monoxide.
strings.曾丽娟塞给 {actor} 一板头孢：“只有这些了。”: Lisa Zeng presses a strip of cephalosporin into {actor}'s hand. “That's all I can spare.”
strings.曾丽娟沉默了一会儿，把药包倒在了卧铺上。: Lisa Zeng is silent for a moment, then tips her medical bag out onto a bunk.
strings.曾丽娟没能把父亲送回长沙。医院的同事来郴州接她，在她的双肩包里找到一个小本子，一: Lisa Zeng never got her father home to Changsha. Colleagues from her hospital came to Chenzhou for her and found a little notebook in her backpack: line after line of everyone's blood pressure, temperature and medication.
strings.曾丽娟被赶下了车。她在后面的车上给人看了三天病，没人知道她叫什么，只知道是个长沙: Lisa Zeng was put off the coach. For three days she treated people in the vehicles further back; nobody knew her name, only that she was a nurse with a Changsha accent.
strings.曾老师在长沙过了年。正月里他给邻居家的孩子讲冻雨是怎么回事，讲着讲着就讲到了高速: Mr. Zeng spent New Year in Changsha. During the holiday he explained freezing rain to the neighbours' children, and from there he got onto those days on the expressway; halfway through, he stopped and took a sip of tea.
strings.曾老师没能回到长沙。他教过的学生凑钱，在学校的物理实验室门口挂了一块小牌子：曾德: Mr. Zeng never got back to Changsha. His former pupils clubbed together for a small plaque by the door of the school physics lab: Edward Zeng taught here, 1962–2000.
strings.曾老师突然从座位上滑了下来，脸色青灰，满头冷汗，硝酸甘油含下去也不管用了。有人跪: Mr. Zeng suddenly slides off his seat, his face grey, drenched in cold sweat; the nitroglycerin does nothing now. Someone kneels in the aisle feeling for his pulse — fast and ragged. A heart attack.
strings.曾老师靠着车窗坐了一夜，谁跟他说话，他都说没事。: Mr. Zeng sits up against the window all night. Whoever speaks to him, he tells them it's nothing.
strings.最壮的几个人抱着石头冲了上去。: The strongest of them rush forward with rocks in their arms.
strings.有人从后备箱里翻出两瓶白酒，拧开盖子：“喝两口，身上就暖和了。”: Someone digs two bottles of baijiu out of a boot and unscrews the cap. “A couple of swigs and you'll warm right up.”
strings.有人从后面的车上换来半袋木炭，在一个旧脸盆里点着了，端上了大巴：“烤一烤，比开暖: Someone has traded for half a sack of charcoal from a car further back, lit it in an old washbasin and carried it onto the coach. “Have a warm — cheaper than running the heater.”
strings.有人帮着挪火桶的时候，看见车厢缝里纸箱上印着“烟花爆竹”四个大字。: Helping to move the barrel, someone spots the word FIREWORKS printed on the cartons through a gap in the trailer doors.
strings.有人把车牌号抄在了本子上。: Someone copies the plate number into a notebook.
strings.有人摇头：“别写我。”{actor} 把手机收了起来。: Someone shakes their head. “Leave me out of it.” {actor} puts the phone away.
strings.有人撕下一页笔记本，一笔一笔写下欠条，每个大人都签了名。: Someone tears a page out of a notebook and writes out an IOU, line by line; every adult signs it.
strings.有人说就是冻的。车窗又关上了。: Someone says it's just the cold. The windows go back up.
strings.有人说，线都断了，哪还有电。: Somebody says the lines are down, so how could there be any power?
strings.有人蹲在路堑边上，跟挑担子的人讲起了价。: Someone squats at the top of the cutting and starts bargaining.
strings.有火有饭；下坡的时候可能有人摔伤，车和货就扔在路上了: Fire and food down there — though someone may fall on the way, and the vehicles and cargo are left on the road
strings.村里也停电了，水泵抽不上水，都是从井里挑的。: No power in the village either. The pump's dead, so it's all water carried up from the well.
strings.架在护栏边上，离车远一点: Put it by the guardrail, well away from the vehicles
strings.柴我去捡，你们歇着。: I'll get the wood. You lot rest.
strings.欠薪的事传开了。过完年，三十多个工人拿着欠条在湘潭找到了他家。罗振华把帕萨特卖了: Word of the unpaid wages got around. After New Year, thirty-odd workers turned up at his house in Xiangtan with their IOUs. Vincent Luo sold the Passat; it still wasn't enough, so he wrote them a new IOU.
strings.正月初一，曾老师在长沙的家里给女儿量了一回血压，说：“你看，比我的还高。”过完年: On New Year's Day, in the family flat in Changsha, Mr. Zeng took his daughter's blood pressure for once and said, “Look at that — higher than mine.” After the holiday Lisa Zeng applied to join her hospital's disaster-response team.
strings.每个大人再掏一些: Every adult chips in a bit more
strings.每扇车窗都摇下一指宽的缝，用胶带贴了个记号。冷风一进来，头疼慢慢轻了。: Every window is wound down a finger's width and marked with tape. As the cold air seeps in, the headaches slowly ease.
strings.求她把丫丫和曾老师带到村里家里烤火: Ask her to take Ava and Mr. Zeng down to her house to sit by the fire
strings.没绑草绳的车，在冰坡上可能打滑: Without straw rope on the tyres, the vehicles may skid on the icy slope
strings.河南周口人，开了二十年长途。车上是十五吨广东四会的砂糖橘，一半是赊来的货，要赶在: From Zhoukou in Henan; twenty years on the long-haul routes. In the back are fifteen tonnes of mandarins from Sihui in Guangdong, half of them bought on credit, which have to reach the wholesale market in Zhengzhou before New Year. A mongrel called Tiger rides in his cab, and his diesel tank is full.
strings.河南话，“中不中”“俺”“咋弄嘞”，急了就拍方向盘。: Henan dialect — “Will that do?”, “Me, I…”, “What we gonna do?” — and he slaps the steering wheel when he gets worked up.
strings.油保住了，人心就难说了: Your fuel stays put — goodwill is another matter
strings.油可以给，三十块一升: You can have the petrol — at thirty yuan a litre
strings.油桶劈开了，垫上几块砖，架在了半挂车的车尾下面。: The drum is split open, propped on a few bricks and set up under the lorry's tailgate.
strings.油桶又被扔回了围挡后面。: The drum is tossed back behind the screens.
strings.油箱盖用铁丝缠上了，旁边放了一根撬棍。: The fuel cap is wired shut, with a crowbar propped beside it.
strings.油迹一直通到后面一辆面包车。车主红着脸把半桶油还了回来。: The trail leads to a minibus further back. Its red-faced owner hands back half a jerrycan.
strings.泡面涨到了 {var.price} 一碗，一个煮鸡蛋要五块。卖东西的人说，村里也: Noodles are up to {var.price} a bowl now, and a boiled egg costs five. The sellers say the village has no power either — the water is carried up from the well and the firewood humped up the slope a bundle at a time.
strings.泡面的价钱: Price of a bowl of noodles
strings.清排气管、开窗缝: Clear the tailpipes, crack the windows
strings.湖北孝感人，在东莞的电子厂做了九年流水线。跟丈夫胡大军带着四岁的女儿丫丫，坐卧铺: From Xiaogan in Hubei; nine years on the assembly line at an electronics factory in Dongguan. She's taking the sleeper coach home to Xiaogan for New Year with her husband, Dan Hu, and their four-year-old daughter, Ava. Their son lives back home with his grandparents; she hasn't seen him in two years.
strings.湖南湘潭人，在东莞开了八年五金厂。一个人开着黑色帕萨特回湘潭过年，油箱是满的，后: From Xiangtan in Hunan; has run a hardware factory in Dongguan for eight years. He's driving his black Passat home to Xiangtan alone for New Year: full tank, good cigarettes and liquor in the boot, and a black combination briefcase he never lets out of his hand.
strings.湖南益阳人，在中山大学读新闻系大三。寒假在广州一家报社实习，搭上这趟回乡的卧铺大: From Yiyang in Hunan; a third-year journalism student at Sun Yat-sen University. He's interning at a Guangzhou paper over the winter break and hopped on this coachload of homeward-bound workers saying it was on his way home — really, he's after a Spring Festival travel story. Two bars left on his phone.
strings.湘潭口音的普通话，开口就是“兄弟”“这样子咯”“钱不是问题”。: Mandarin with a Xiangtan accent; it's always “brother”, “here's the thing” and “money's no problem”.
strings.湘西人，入伍刚一年。这是他第一次出这么远的任务：跟着中队从郴州城边一路凿冰凿上来: From western Hunan, a year into his service. This is his first real deployment: his company has been chipping its way up the road from the edge of Chenzhou, and his gloves wore through long ago.
strings.湘西口音，开口之前先立正。: Western Hunan accent; stands to attention before he speaks.
strings.火旺，人也能凑在车边取暖: It'll burn well, and people can warm up right beside the vehicles
strings.火桶摆在了半挂车车尾避风的地方，火星子被风一卷，直往车厢底下飘。你知道车厢最里头: The fire barrel has been set up in the lee of the lorry's tailgate, and the wind keeps whirling sparks under the trailer. You know what's packed at the very back.
strings.火桶架在了护栏边上，离大巴有十几步远。: The barrel goes up by the guardrail, a dozen paces from the coach.
strings.火桶立起来了。第一把湿树枝冒了半天白烟，浇上一点柴油，呼的一声着了。几个人伸着手: The fire barrel is up. The first armful of wet branches smokes white for ages; a splash of diesel, and it catches with a whoomp. People crowd round with their hands out, and nobody says a word.
strings.火桶里的柴烧光了，火灭了。: The fire barrel has burned through its wood and gone out.
strings.炭盆搁在了车门边，门缝里呼呼地往里灌风。: The basin sits by the door, and cold air whistles in through the gap.
strings.炭盆红红的，车里一下子暖和起来，大家围着它烤手。: The basin glows red, the coach warms up at once, and everyone crowds round it holding out their hands.
strings.烟花爆竹的事传到了交警那里。牛长海挨了罚款，二十箱货全被没收。那年的年三十，村里: Word of the fireworks reached the traffic police. Hank Niu was fined and all twenty cases were confiscated. That New Year's Eve, not one string of firecrackers set off in his village had come home on his lorry.
strings.烧掉帕萨特里六升汽油: Burns six litres of the Passat's petrol
strings.热心，话多，好奇，什么都想记下来；有点书生气，看不惯不公平的事，爱讲道理，真要动: Eager, talkative and curious; wants to write everything down. A bit bookish — can't stand unfairness and loves to argue the point, but goes to pieces when it comes to actually doing something.
strings.热闹；有人会输: Livens things up — and somebody will lose
strings.爬上路堑找信号: Climb the cutting for a signal
strings.爬上路堑，把被冰压断的树枝和竹子拖下来，砍成段。柴是湿的，得靠火桶慢慢烤干。坡上: Climb the cutting and drag down branches and bamboo snapped by the ice, then chop them up. The wood is wet and has to dry out slowly by the barrel. The slope is steep and slick, and the ice-laden branches overhead can snap at any moment.
strings.爬到路堑顶上的竹林边，那里手机偶尔有一格信号：给 122 和家里打电话、发短信，: Climb to the bamboo at the top of the cutting, where a phone sometimes gets one bar: call 122 and your families, send texts, let the outside world know people are still stuck on this stretch. Uses 1 bar of battery each time; with an engine running, a car charger puts a little back. When Felix Yi makes the calls, they can turn into a newspaper story.
strings.爱讲道理，脾气倔，不愿给女儿添麻烦，胸口疼也忍着不说。: Loves to explain things, obstinate, hates being a burden to his daughter, and says nothing when his chest hurts.
strings.爱说话，怕黑，困了就哭。: Chatty, scared of the dark, cries when she's tired.
strings.父亲是在高速上走的。曾丽娟把他的老花镜和那板没吃完的硝酸甘油放进一个铁盒子里。回: Her father died on the expressway. Lisa Zeng keeps his reading glasses and the half-finished strip of nitroglycerin in a tin box. Back in A&E, whenever an old man comes in with chest pain, she stays by him a little longer.
strings.父亲被抬去了收费站。救护车上缺一个能照看他的人，可车上的人也离不开你。: Your father has been stretchered down to the toll station. The ambulance needs someone to look after him — but the people on the coach can hardly spare you either.
strings.牛长海半夜醒来，正看见有人蹲在他的油箱边上。: Hank Niu wakes in the night to find somebody crouched by his fuel tank.
strings.牛长海没能把那车橘子拉到郑州。半挂车后来被拖车拖走了，车厢里的橘子冻成了一块一块: Hank Niu never got his mandarins to Zhengzhou. A tow truck hauled the lorry away; the fruit in the back had frozen into lumps and was dumped at a tip outside Chenzhou. People back home say he had meant this to be his last run.
strings.牛长海被赶下了大巴，回到自己的驾驶室里，抱着虎子过了几夜。路通的那天，他一个人把: Hank Niu was put off the coach and went back to his own cab, where he spent the nights with his arms round Tiger. The day the road opened he drove the lorry out alone and never looked back.
strings.现在什么都涨价，一公斤十块: Everything's gone up — ten yuan a kilo
strings.用冰搓一搓，老辈人说这样好得快: Rub them with ice — the old folk say that heals them faster
strings.用掉 1 格电；外面会知道这一段困着人: Uses 1 bar of battery — and the outside world will learn people are stranded here
strings.田埂上闪过一道蓝光。: A blue flash crackles along the field edge.
strings.田秀芬和胡大军的女儿: Fiona Tian and Dan Hu's daughter
strings.田秀芬咬着嘴唇拆开了线。: Biting her lip, Fiona Tian unpicks the seam.
strings.田秀芬没能回到孝感。老家的人后来收到了她的棉袄，夹层里的钱一张不少，针脚密密的。: Fiona Tian never made it back to Xiaogan. Her jacket was sent home later; the money in the lining was all there, every note, behind the close little stitches.
strings.田秀芬没能回到孝感。胡大军回了老家，那件缝着钱的棉袄，他一直没舍得拆。儿子问妈妈: Fiona Tian never made it back to Xiaogan. Dan Hu went home; the jacket with the money sewn into it he could never bring himself to unpick. When their son asked where Mum was, he said: “Mum's still on the road.”
strings.田秀芬犹豫了很久，拆开线，数出十张递了过来：“就这些，别跟别人说。”: Fiona Tian hesitates a long time, then unpicks the seam and counts out ten notes. “That's all. Don't tell the others.”
strings.田秀芬的丈夫，钢筋工: Fiona Tian's husband; a steel fixer
strings.田秀芬瞪着你：“你看错了。”: Fiona Tian glares back. “You saw wrong.”
strings.田秀芬被赶下了车。她在后面一辆大巴的过道里蹲了几夜，天天顺着车流走回来，隔着车窗: Fiona Tian was put off the coach. She spent the nights crouched in the aisle of another coach further back, and every day she walked back up the line to look at Ava through the window.
strings.电话打了七八遍才通。那头的人说，全市的线都断了，抢修的人手根本不够。: It takes seven or eight tries to get through. The voice at the other end says lines are down all over the city and there aren't nearly enough crews.
strings.电话拨了好几遍才通。: It takes several tries to get through.
strings.电话那头沉默了很久，然后说：“我们等你。”: There's a long silence at the other end. Then: “We'll wait for you.”
strings.电话那头说，会尽快派人。: The voice on the line says someone will be sent as soon as possible.
strings.留下来，父亲有战士和医生管着: Stay — the soldiers and the doctors will look after him
strings.留他在大巴上，一起过: Have him stay on the coach with everyone
strings.皱巴巴的票子凑了一小沓。: A small wad of crumpled notes is scraped together.
strings.盐撒在冰上，冰点就降下去了，所以他们要撒盐。: Put salt on ice and you lower its freezing point. That's why they spread salt.
strings.省下钱，挨着饿；村民里也有实在人，这话不好听: Saves the money, means going hungry — and not every villager is a crook
strings.省事；万一线上还有电呢: Less trouble — unless there's still current in those lines
strings.知道前面的情况，心里有底；冰面上走夜路，要摔跤: You'd know what you're up against — but walking on ice in the dark means falls
strings.砂糖橘：一公斤大约 360 千卡、六百多毫升水分。能顶饿、能解渴，可一个人一顿吃: Mandarins: a kilo holds about 360 kcal and over 600 ml of water. They stave off hunger and thirst, but no one can eat that many at a sitting, and ice-cold fruit leaves you colder.
strings.破窗那头的卧铺空了出来，冻雨在上面结了一层冰。: The bunks by the broken windows are abandoned, and the freezing rain glazes them with ice.
strings.硬塞给她二十块: Press twenty yuan on her anyway
strings.离得够远，没事: It's far enough away. It'll be fine
strings.私下求她匀一点给伤病的人: Quietly ask her to spare a little for the sick and injured
strings.私下跟她说：买吃的的钱快没了，能不能匀一点: Have a quiet word: the kitty's nearly gone — could she spare a little?
strings.私下问他录这些干什么: Quietly ask him what it's all for
strings.秘密保不住了，可不会出事: The secret's out — but nothing will blow up
strings.秘密保不住了，可话说出去就得算数: The secret's out — and once you've said it, you have to stand by it
strings.竹子砸在{actor}的背上和胳膊上，冰碴溅了一身。: The bamboo crashes across {actor}'s back and arms, showering {actor.him} with ice.
strings.第{day}天下午，车流终于动了。大巴碾着盐粒爬上了坡顶，后视镜里，那段冰道越来: On the afternoon of day {day} the traffic finally moves. The coach grinds over the salt to the top of the slope, and in the mirrors the stretch of ice falls further and further behind. {aliveCount} people, not one missing. At the toll station someone gets out to phone home and ends up crouched on the ground in tears. There are still a few days to New Year's Eve.
strings.第{day}天了，前面还是一动不动。有人摊开一张皱巴巴的地图：往前八公里是收费站: Day {day}, and still nothing ahead is moving. Someone spreads out a crumpled map: eight kilometres on are the toll station and a service area — food, telephones, and word is the government is handing out quilts. But it's eight kilometres of ice.
strings.第{day}天，冰终于被凿开了。活着离开的人：{survivors}。没能等到这: On day {day} the ice is finally broken through. Those who left alive: {survivors}. Those who did not live to see it: {dead}. That Spring Festival, at more than one New Year's Eve table, an extra bowl and pair of chopsticks were laid.
strings.第{day}天，路通了。武警战士站在冰坡两边，一辆一辆地放车。活着离开这段路的人: On day {day} the road opens. Soldiers stand on both sides of the icy slope, waving the vehicles through one at a time. Those who left that stretch of road alive: {survivors}. Those who stayed: {dead}. As the vehicles round the bend, nobody says a word.
strings.第九天傍晚，前面的车还是没动。收费站派来的大客车停在八公里外，战士们一趟一趟地把: By the evening of the ninth day the traffic ahead still hasn't moved. Coaches sent from the toll station wait eight kilometres away, and the soldiers ferry people across to them, trip after trip. Those who got on alive: {survivors}. Those who didn't live to see it: {dead}. This stretch of road opened two days later.
strings.第九天傍晚，路还没有通。可武警送来了棉被和热饭，收费站那边也派了大客车来接人。{: By the evening of the ninth day the road still isn't open. But the armed police have brought quilts and hot food, and the toll station has sent coaches to fetch people. {aliveCount} of them, not one missing, climb aboard. That New Year's Eve some of them spent on the road; some made it home for the dinner.
strings.等回了孝感，先睡它三天。: Once we're back in Xiaogan, I'm sleeping for three days straight.
strings.算了，一个人跑了，算怎么回事: Forget it. What kind of man runs off on his own?
strings.精明、讲义气，可更讲钱；认死理，脾气上来谁也劝不住。心疼他的货，也心疼人，只是嘴: Shrewd and loyal, but loyal to money first; stubborn as a mule, and once his temper goes no one can talk him round. He frets over his cargo and over people too — though he would never admit the second.
strings.红薯两块钱一个，管饱不贵；他一个人挑不了多少: Two yuan a sweet potato — filling and cheap, but one old man can't carry much
strings.红薯是自家地里的，钱给不给都要得。: The sweet potatoes are from my own field. Pay or don't, it's all the same to me.
strings.纸箱板用胶带一层层粘上，外面再压一床被子。: Cardboard is taped up layer upon layer, with a quilt jammed over the top.
strings.线都断了，哪还有电？下村子照旧走近路: With the lines down there can't be any power — keep using the short way down
strings.给他们送口热水和吃的: Bring them some hot water and food
strings.给他含一片硝酸甘油，扶他半躺着，别让他动: Put a nitroglycerin tablet under his tongue, prop him half upright, keep him still
strings.罗振华回了湘潭，再也没回东莞。他在县城开了一家小小的五金店，自己守店，一个工人也: Vincent Luo went back to Xiangtan and never returned to Dongguan. He opened a little hardware shop in the county town and minds it himself; he doesn't employ a single worker.
strings.罗振华在路上就给厂里的工人打了电话。回到东莞，他照着工资条，一个一个把密码箱里的: Vincent Luo phoned his workers from the road. Back in Dongguan he paid them one by one, off the payslips, out of the briefcase. What was left was just enough to lock up the factory gate.
strings.罗振华开着帕萨特回到湘潭，正赶上年三十。他给每个亲戚都包了红包，酒桌上讲起高速上: Vincent Luo drove the Passat into Xiangtan on New Year's Eve itself. He gave every relative a red envelope, and over the drinks he told the story of those days on the expressway — who had come begging him for petrol, and so on. Where the money in the briefcase came from, he never told a soul.
strings.罗振华沉着脸，从钱包里抽出一沓钱拍在了卧铺上。: Stony-faced, Vincent Luo pulls a wad from his wallet and slaps it down on a bunk.
strings.罗振华没能回到湘潭。交警清点滞留车辆的时候打开了那只密码箱，里面的十八万后来被法: Vincent Luo never made it back to Xiangtan. When the traffic police went through the stranded vehicles they opened the briefcase; a court later awarded the 180,000 inside to the thirty-odd workers from his factory. Their wages came a year late — but every fen of them.
strings.罗振华犹豫了一下，还是把车钥匙递了过来：“开吧开吧，油不够再说。”: Vincent Luo hesitates, then hands over the keys. “Go on, run it. We'll worry about the petrol later.”
strings.老人和孩子能先离开冰道，孩子的爸爸跟着走；剩下的人接着等: The old man and the child get off the ice first, with the child's father going along; everyone else keeps waiting
strings.老婆婆把钱塞回来，又被塞回去，最后揣进了围裙兜里。: The old woman pushes the money back, has it pushed back at her, and finally tucks it into her apron pocket.
strings.老婆婆连声说要得要得，回头就去喊了两个后生来背人。: The old woman says yes, of course, and goes straight off to fetch two young men to do the carrying.
strings.胡大军一晚上输了两百块，田秀芬气得一夜没理他。: Dan Hu loses two hundred yuan in one evening, and Fiona Tian doesn't speak to him all night.
strings.胡大军回到孝感，在村口的小卖部里坐了一整个正月，一句话也不说，一瓶接一瓶地喝。: Dan Hu went home to Xiaogan and sat in the village shop for the whole first month of the year, not saying a word, drinking one bottle after another.
strings.胡大军没能回家。工地上的工友凑了钱，把他送回了孝感。: Dan Hu never made it home. His mates from the site clubbed together to send him back to Xiaogan.
strings.胡大军过完年没再去东莞，在孝感的工地上接着扎钢筋，骑摩托离家半个钟头。丫丫上幼儿: After New Year Dan Hu didn't go back to Dongguan. He ties rebar on sites round Xiaogan now, half an hour from home by motorbike. On Ava's first day at kindergarten, he took her on the back.
strings.胳膊上肯定要挨几下: Your arms are going to take some blows
strings.能便宜一点，也可能把人得罪了: You might get it cheaper — or put their backs up
strings.能动的人都去: Everyone who can still move goes
strings.能吃苦，精打细算，平时不爱出头；可一碰到孩子的事，什么都豁得出去。对有钱人有一种: Tough and thrifty, never one to push herself forward — but where her children are concerned, she'll stop at nothing. She has a wariness of rich people she couldn't put into words.
strings.能多开两夜暖风；被他撞见就是仇: Two more nights of heat — and if he catches you, he'll never forgive it
strings.能说会道，爱面子，习惯拿钱摆平事情；骨子里怕吃亏，也怕死。对谁都客客气气，可自己: Smooth-talking and proud, used to settling things with money; deep down he's afraid of losing out, and afraid of dying. Polite to everyone, but he won't give an inch where his own things are concerned.
strings.脚趾头又痒又疼，肿得发亮。鞋袜从上车起就没干过。: Toes itching and burning, swollen and shiny. Socks that haven't been dry since the coach set off.
strings.脱下鞋袜，在暖风口或火桶边慢慢烘干: Take your shoes and socks off and dry them slowly by a heater vent or the barrel
strings.腊月二十九，一家人进了孝感老家的门。儿子躲在奶奶身后，不肯叫妈。田秀芬从棉袄里拆: On the twenty-ninth they walked through the door of the old house in Xiaogan. Their son hid behind his grandmother and wouldn't call her Mum. Fiona Tian unpicked the money from her jacket, laid the notes out on the bed one by one, and counted them three times.
strings.腊月二十八，牛长海的半挂车开进了郑州的批发市场。橘子冻坏了三成，剩下的一斤少卖了: On the twenty-eighth of the twelfth month, Hank Niu's lorry pulled into the Zhengzhou wholesale market. A third of the fruit had frozen; he sold the rest fifty fen a jin cheaper and walked through his own front door on New Year's Eve itself. The first thing he did was drink a big bowl of hot soup.
strings.腼腆，能扛，见了男的叫“师傅”，见了女的叫“阿姨”。: Shy and tough; calls every man “boss” and every woman “auntie”.
strings.自己的口粮少一点: Your own rations get a little thinner
strings.自己都顾不过来: You can barely look after yourselves
strings.花二十块，封得严实: Costs twenty yuan, seals it properly
strings.药片含下去十来分钟，曾老师的呼吸慢慢匀了。: Ten minutes after the tablet goes under his tongue, Mr. Zeng's breathing slowly evens out.
strings.药片碾碎了拌在糖水里，一勺一勺喂了下去。: A tablet is crushed into sugared water and spooned into her bit by bit.
strings.药能拿出来用；她会难堪: The drugs could be used — and she'll be humiliated
strings.虎子叼着半个馒头，跑到车门边趴下吃了。: Tiger carries off half a steamed bun and lies down by the coach door to eat it.
strings.虎子在路堑边上嗅了嗅，钻进了竹林。: Tiger sniffs along the edge of the cutting and slips into the bamboo.
strings.虎子在门口趴了一夜。: Tiger lies by the door all night.
strings.虎子摇着尾巴，叼走了半块饼干。: Tiger wags his tail and makes off with half a biscuit.
strings.虎子没能下高速。有人把它埋在了路堑上面的竹林里，插了一根树枝当记号。: Tiger never got off the expressway. Someone buried him in the bamboo above the cutting and stuck a branch in the ground to mark the spot.
strings.虎子趴在车门口，眼巴巴地看着大家手里的吃的，肚子瘪下去一大块。: Tiger lies by the coach door, gazing at the food in everyone's hands, his belly sunk in.
strings.虎子跟着回了周口。后来每次出车，它都先跳上驾驶座，坐着等。: Tiger went home to Zhoukou. Ever since, whenever the lorry goes out, he jumps up into the driver's seat first and sits there, waiting.
strings.虎子顺着车流跑远了，再也没回来。: Tiger trots off down the line of traffic and never comes back.
strings.被冰压断的树枝和竹子、拆开的木货板。湿的，得靠火桶慢慢烧。: Branches and bamboo snapped by the ice, broken-up pallets. All of it wet; it burns slowly, in the barrel.
strings.被冰压断的树枝砸中: struck by a branch broken off by the ice
strings.被子、大衣都搬上了大巴的卧铺。罗振华犹豫了一下，还是锁上帕萨特，上了大巴。: Quilts and coats are carried onto the coach's bunks. Vincent Luo hesitates, then locks the Passat and climbs aboard.
strings.被溜坡的货车撞伤: crushed when the lorry slid back
strings.被赶下车以后，罗振华在帕萨特里坐了很久，后来沿着应急车道往前走了。有人在收费站的: After he was put off the coach, Vincent Luo sat in his Passat for a long time, then set off up the hard shoulder on foot. Someone saw him later at the emergency shelter by the toll station, hugging a black briefcase.
strings.要看守着他的人懂不懂: Depends on whether whoever's with him knows what they're doing
strings.认了，人家也不容易: Accept it — they're having a hard time too
strings.认了：厂子垮了，钱在箱子里，回去就发: Own up: the factory's bust, the money's in the case, and they'll be paid when you get back
strings.让曾丽娟从包里拿药: Get Lisa Zeng to take something out of her bag
strings.让武警把中毒最重的人抬到收费站的救护车上: Have the soldiers stretcher the worst cases down to the ambulance at the toll station
strings.让父亲活着回长沙过年: Get your father home to Changsha alive for New Year
strings.让田秀芬从棉袄里拿一千出来: Ask Fiona Tian for a thousand out of her jacket
strings.让老人和孩子晚上睡到我车里来，暖风开着: Let the old man and the child sleep in my car at night with the heater on
strings.记下车牌，等交警来了举报他: Note his plate and report him when the police come
strings.记者拍了几个车窗，去了下一辆车。: The reporter films a few windows and moves on to the next vehicle.
strings.讲到最后，一碗泡面让到了七块。: In the end they come down to seven a bowl.
strings.讲到最后，六升油九十块。: In the end it's six litres for ninety yuan.
strings.说完自己心里也好受些: Saying it makes you feel better too
strings.说实话：困在高速上，不知道哪天能走: Tell the truth: stuck on the expressway, no idea when you'll get away
strings.说对方打错了，挂掉: Say it's a wrong number and hang up
strings.说得好听，人在哪呢: Easy to say. So where are they?
strings.说快到了，别担心: Say you're nearly there — not to worry
strings.请战士先把老人和孩子背到收费站的救护车上: Ask the soldiers to carry the old man and the child down to the ambulance at the toll station first
strings.请战士把她背到收费站的救护车上: Ask the soldiers to carry her down to the ambulance
strings.谁也不欠谁；几台发动机一起烧，油下去得快: Nobody owes anybody — but with several engines burning at once, the fuel goes fast
strings.谢满仓后来每天还是挑着担子上路堑，一直挑到最后一辆车开走。: Marvin Xie went on climbing the embankment with his pole every day, until the very last car had gone.
strings.谢满仓在前面踩出一串脚印。: Marvin Xie treads out a line of footprints ahead of them.
strings.谢满仓在前面踩着脚印，一行人扶着护栏、拽着竹子，从路堑上一点一点挪了下去。村里没: Marvin Xie went first, treading out footholds, and the rest edged down the cutting after him, clinging to the guardrail and hauling on bamboo. The village had no power, but in every house the wood stove glowed red, with cured pork hanging above it. Those who made it down: {survivors}. Those who didn't: {dead}. Only when the road opened did they climb back up to the vehicles, by which time the ice on the roofs was half gone.
strings.谢满仓没能再挑着担子回村。出殡那天，坳上村的人在路堑底下放了一挂鞭炮，高速上的车: Marvin Xie never carried his pole home again. On the day of his funeral, the people of Aoshang let off a string of firecrackers at the foot of the cutting, and the cars up on the expressway sounded their horns for a long time.
strings.谢满仓点点头，没再劝。: Marvin Xie nods and doesn't press it.
strings.谢满仓蹲在车门边抽完一袋烟，说：“莫在这里冻着了。跟我下去，村里家家有柴火灶，挤: Marvin Xie finishes his pipe by the coach door and says: “Don't stay up here freezing. Come down with me. Every house in the village has a wood stove, and we'll squeeze you in. I know the path — there's less ice on it.” But it's a steep slope, and the vehicles and everything in them would have to stay behind.
strings.谢满仓领着他们下了坡，说明天再上来送水。: Marvin Xie leads them down the slope, promising to bring water up tomorrow.
strings.谢老汉把铁锅往车门边一放，蹲下来就开始敲冰。: Mr. Xie sets his iron pot down by the coach door, squats and starts breaking up ice.
strings.谢老汉推了半天钱，最后收下十块，挑着空担子下去了。: Mr. Xie pushes the money away again and again; in the end he takes ten yuan and goes back down with his empty baskets.
strings.谢谢他，大家守着车: Thank him — everyone stays with the vehicles
strings.谢谢他，给他钱，让他回村里去: Thank him, pay him and send him home to the village
strings.货保住了，人心就不好说了: The load stays safe — people's goodwill is another matter
strings.货车撞进了大巴的车头，车里的人被甩得东倒西歪。: The lorry smashes into the front of the coach, throwing everyone inside off their feet.
strings.货车没停住。冲在最前面的人被车尾扫倒在冰上。: The lorry doesn't stop. The one in front is swept off their feet by its tail.
strings.货车溜了十几米，在离大巴两米的地方停住了。: The lorry slides a dozen metres and stops two metres from the coach.
strings.货车溜了十几米，横在了大巴前面两米的地方。: The lorry slides a dozen metres and stops crosswise, two metres short of the coach.
strings.货车的后轮卡在了石头上，停住了。司机跳下来，腿还在抖。: The lorry's back wheels catch on the rocks and it stops. The driver jumps down, legs still shaking.
strings.货车的车尾撞进了大巴的车头，挡风玻璃碎了一地。: The lorry's tail ploughs into the front of the coach and the windscreen shatters.
strings.费点工夫，以后下路堑的人心里有数: Takes a bit of effort, but anyone going down the cutting will know where not to tread
strings.跟下去，守着父亲: Go down after him and stay by his side
strings.跟别的车换一块塑料布钉上: Trade another vehicle for a plastic sheet and fix it over the gap
strings.跟大家说实话，把火桶挪走: Tell everyone the truth and get the barrel moved
strings.跟村民换来草绳，再拆些铁丝，跪在冰水里一圈一圈缠在大巴和小车的驱动轮上。路一通，: Get straw rope from the villagers, strip some wire, and kneel in the icy slush winding it round and round the drive wheels of the coach and the cars. When the road opens, it's what will get the vehicles up this slope.
strings.跟着战士，所有人一起走到八公里外的收费站: Follow the soldiers — everyone walks the eight kilometres to the toll station
strings.跟着车流，一辆一辆慢慢开出去: Fall in with the traffic and creep out one vehicle at a time
strings.跨过去，线都断了，哪来的电: Step over it — the line's down, how can it be live?
strings.路堑底下坳上村的村民: A villager from Aoshang, at the foot of the cutting
strings.路堑底下的村民卖一碗泡面要多少钱。: What the villagers at the foot of the embankment charge for a bowl of instant noodles.
strings.路边的施工围挡后面扔着一只空油桶，还有半捆生锈的钢筋。有人敲了敲桶壁：“劈开、打: Behind the roadworks screens on the verge someone finds an empty oil drum and half a bundle of rusty rebar. Somebody raps the side of the drum. “Split it, punch some holes — that's a fire barrel. Good for drying clothes and melting ice.” The question is where to put it: the lorry's tailgate gives shelter from the wind; the guardrail is windy, but well away from the vehicles.
strings.路通以后，谢满仓的担子又挑了好几天，帮着收费站给还没走的人送饭。年后有一辆湖北牌: After the road opened Marvin Xie kept carrying his loads up for days, helping the toll station feed the people still stranded. After New Year a coach with Hubei plates made a point of stopping at the village entrance; the people on it left him a box of Xiaogan sesame brittle and a red silk banner.
strings.车上的人还用得着你: The people here still need you
strings.车上能动的人都拿起了家伙，跟着战士们一起凿。: Everyone who can still move picks up a tool and starts chipping alongside the soldiers.
strings.车厢是被人撬开的，橘子一筐一筐被搬走。牛长海后来逢人就讲那几天的事，讲到撬车厢那: The trailer was forced open and the mandarins carried off crate by crate. Hank Niu tells the story to anyone who'll listen, and when he gets to the moment the doors were broken he always stops for a drag on his cigarette. He never drove the Jingzhu again.
strings.车厢最里头、橘子筐后面压着二十箱烟花爆竹，是帮老乡捎的私货，一箱能挣一百块。你没: Right at the back of the trailer, behind the crates of mandarins, are twenty cases of fireworks you're carrying on the side for a man from home — a hundred yuan a case. You have no hazardous-goods permit: get caught and they fine you and impound the lorry. Let them get too close to a fire and it could be far worse.
strings.车厢里一声闷响，最里头那几箱一起炸了。冲上去的人被气浪掀翻在冰上。: There's a muffled boom inside the trailer as the cases at the back go up together. The people who rushed in are thrown flat on the ice.
strings.车在，东西在，路一通就能走: The vehicles and everything in them stay safe, ready to go the moment the road opens
strings.车载收音机里断断续续：“……国务院紧急部署……湖南全省电网……部队正连夜赶往京珠: The car radio crackles in and out: “…emergency measures from the State Council… the entire Hunan power grid… troops are travelling through the night to the Jingzhu Expressway… stranded drivers and passengers are urged not to abandon their vehicles…”
strings.车边上烧火太危险，算了: Fire next to the vehicles is too dangerous — forget it
strings.车里不止一个人听清了“工钱”两个字。: More than one person on the coach caught the word “wages”.
strings.车里会冷一些，可再也不能出这种事了: The vehicles will be colder, but this can never happen again
strings.车里冷死了，就放在中间: It's freezing in here — put it in the middle
strings.车里早早熄了灯。: The lights in the coach go out early.
strings.车里有暖风，可大巴油箱里的柴油只剩小半箱；吃的只有各人包里带的年货和零食。手机信: There is heat in the vehicles, but the coach's tank is less than half full; the only food is what people packed for the holiday and the snacks in their bags. The phone signal comes and goes. The radio says the whole of the Jingzhu Expressway in Hunan is closed. New Year's Eve is eleven days away.
strings.车里没人说话。: Nobody in the coach says a word.
strings.车里照样冷；木炭可以拿去火桶里烧: It stays cold inside — but the charcoal can go in the fire barrel
strings.车里的人都转过头来。田秀芬下意识地捂住了棉袄的衣襟。: Every head in the coach turns. Without thinking, Fiona Tian clutches the front of her jacket.
strings.车门关上了。挑担子的人愣了一下，挑着箩筐去了后面的车。: The door shuts. The villagers stand there a moment, then carry their baskets on to the cars behind.
strings.输了的人骂骂咧咧地扛着扳手下了车。: The losers grumble their way off the coach with spanners.
strings.近；万一线上还有电呢: It's shorter — unless there's still current in it
strings.这是发国难财，不买: This is profiteering from a disaster. Don't buy
strings.这样的冰，三十年冇见过。: Ice like this — I haven't seen the like in thirty years.
strings.这段冰道上的人，最后是一个一个、一拨一拨离开的：有的被抬走，有的自己走，有的开着: In the end the people on that stretch of ice left one by one, a few at a time — some carried, some on foot, some squeezing a car out of the jam. Those who got away: {survivors}. Those who didn't: {dead}. On the day the road opened, the coach was still standing where it had stopped, the tape on its windows flapping in the wind.
strings.这车橘子不能让人白拿: Nobody gets this lorryload of mandarins for free
strings.退休的中学物理老师，曾丽娟的父亲: Retired secondary-school physics teacher; Lisa Zeng's father
strings.那个卖红薯的谢老汉又上来了。这回他背着一口铁锅、一捆干稻草，扁担上还挑着一桶热水: The old sweet-potato seller, Mr. Xie, has come up again. This time he has an iron pot and a bundle of dry straw on his back and a bucket of hot water on his shoulder pole. The village has no power either, he says, and he's on his own at home, so he may as well come up and lend a hand.
strings.那是人家一年的血汗钱: It's a whole year's sweat and toil
strings.那是给她父亲的，不说: They're for her father. Say nothing
strings.那车橘子，牛长海最后一箱一箱地分给了路上的人。回到周口，赊的货款他还了两年。有人: In the end Hank Niu gave his mandarins away, crate by crate, to the people stranded on that road. Back in Zhoukou it took him two years to pay off the fruit he'd bought on credit. When people ask if it was worth it, he says: “I lost money, sure. But for a few days the whole road called me the Mandarin Man.”
strings.部队和抢险队伍往这一段赶的进度。到 100，武警就到了。: How close the troops and relief crews are to this stretch. At 100 the armed police arrive.
strings.郴州宜章的土话，外地人听不大懂，就连说带比划。: A thick local dialect from Yizhang that outsiders barely follow, so he talks with his hands as well.
strings.都挤到大巴上，只开大巴的暖风: Everyone onto the coach — run only the coach's heater
strings.都挤到车厢另一头去: Everyone squeeze up at the other end of the coach
strings.都早点睡，省点力气: Everyone get some sleep and save their strength
strings.钱一张一张递了下去。: The notes are handed down one by one.
strings.钱是你的，橘子只有十五公斤，大家会记着: The money's yours — but it's only fifteen kilos, and they'll remember
strings.铁锹、扳手、撬棍，能用的全用上了。: Shovels, spanners, crowbars — everything that can be used is put to use.
strings.锁被撬开了。牛长海冲过来，被两个人拦住，眼看着橘子一箱一箱被搬走，一句话也没说。: The lock gives. Hank Niu rushes over and two people hold him back; he watches the crates carried off one by one without a word.
strings.长沙人，在广州一家医院的急诊科做了八年护士。开着自己的银色小车，带退休的父亲回长: From Changsha; eight years as a nurse in the A&E department of a Guangzhou hospital. She's driving her retired father home to Changsha for New Year in her little silver car. He has coronary heart disease and had a stent put in two years ago. The car is low on petrol.
strings.长沙话，“咯是”“冇得事”“莫慌咯”；说起医学上的事又快又准。: Changsha dialect — “Is that it?”, “It's nothing”, “Don't panic” — and quick and exact about anything medical.
strings.长沙话，讲起物理来一套一套的。: Changsha dialect; once he gets onto physics there's no stopping him.
strings.长长的一队人扶着护栏，踩着战士们凿出来的台阶，一步一步往坡下挪。: A long line of people inches down the slope, clinging to the guardrail, stepping in the footholds the soldiers have cut.
strings.问了一圈，大家都缺吃少喝，没人有多余的: Asked all round. Everyone is short of food and water; no one has anything to spare
strings.闷头干活，护着老婆孩子，看不惯有钱人摆谱。: Keeps his head down and works; fiercely protective of his wife and daughter; can't stand rich men throwing their weight around.
strings.阿姨，这个馒头还是热的，给伢吃。: Auntie, this bun's still warm. For the little one.
strings.雨停了，天还是铅灰色的。冰一点也没有要化的意思。: The rain has stopped, but the sky is still the colour of lead. The ice shows no sign of melting.
strings.雨落在哪儿就冻在哪儿：车窗、电线、树枝、路面。每个人的头发上都挂着冰碴。: The rain freezes wherever it lands — windows, power lines, branches, the road. Everyone's hair is beaded with ice.
strings.雾浓得看不清十米外的车，树枝和护栏上结满了雾凇。: The fog is so thick you can't see a car ten metres away. Rime has grown on every branch and rail.
strings.面包车司机去敲了下一辆车的窗。: The minibus driver moves on to the next window.
strings.面包车司机拎着桶走了：“后面有的是人要。”: The minibus driver picks up his cans and leaves. “Plenty of others want it.”
strings.顺势往后坐，护住头: Let yourself sit back and protect your head
strings.顺着油迹去后面的车找: Follow the trail of diesel to the cars behind
strings.顺着结冰的路堑爬下去，跟坳上村的村民买泡面、煮鸡蛋、红薯和开水。一趟大约能买回: Climb down the iced-over cutting and buy noodles, boiled eggs, sweet potatoes and hot water from the Aoshang villagers. One trip brings back about 1,600 kcal of food and a couple of litres of hot water, for the price of five bowls of noodles (currently {var.price} a bowl). The whole cutting is ice.
strings.顺着车流往前往后走，挨个敲车窗：打听消息，讨点吃的喝的，用东西换柴油和木头。越往: Walk up and down the line knocking on windows: ask for news, beg a bit of food and water, trade for diesel and wood. The longer this goes on, the less anyone can spare.
strings.风大，烧得费柴；可车边上不会有火星: Windy, so it eats firewood — but no sparks near the vehicles
strings.马上端出去，车里不能烧炭: Get it out right now — no burning charcoal inside
strings.黄黑花的土狗，三岁，跟着牛长海跑了两年长途。夜里睡在驾驶座底下，有人靠近车厢就叫: A brown-and-black mongrel, three years old, who has ridden with Hank Niu for two years. He sleeps under the driver's seat and barks if anyone goes near the trailer.
strings.（叼回来一只不知道是谁的手套，放在丫丫脚边）: (brings back somebody's glove and drops it at Ava's feet)
strings.（往手上哈了口气，又去敲冰）: (blows on his hands and goes back to chipping at the ice)
strings.（悄悄把手按在胸口上，过了一会儿又放下）: (quietly presses a hand to his chest, then after a while lowers it again)
strings.（把一捆干稻草塞进火桶底下）: (stuffs a bundle of dry straw into the bottom of the fire barrel)
strings.（甩了甩冻僵的手，又抡起了十字镐）: (shakes out his frozen hands and swings the pickaxe again)
strings.（缩成一团挤在火桶边上，毛上的冰碴慢慢化开）: (curls up tight against the fire barrel while the ice in his fur slowly melts)
strings.（舔着护栏上化下来的冰水）: (licks the meltwater dripping off the guardrail)
strings.（趴在半挂车的轮子边上，冲着黑处低低地叫了两声）: (lies by the lorry's wheels and growls twice into the dark)
